data.original_title: The Quiet, the Cruel and the Outlaw
data.overview: As the American Civil War tears through the frontier, a taciturn drifter, a merciless gunman, and a Mexican bandit follow rumors of a strongbox holding a fortune in stolen gold. Each needs the others, and none can trust them.
data.tagline: The war taught them how to hunt one another.
data.title: The Quiet, the Cruel and the Outlaw
